author: GNiendorf
body:
#### PR description:

This PR speeds up the MD, LS, T3 and T4 building of LST. Each counting kernel stores the pair decisions it evaluates in a bit mask, up to a fixed number per object, so the creation kernel does not evaluate those pairs again. The T3 and T4 kernels run flat over their inner objects instead of one block per module. Track candidates are unchanged.

**What changes**
- **MD**: `CountMiniDoublets` runs one thread per lower hit and stores the decisions for its first 64 upper hits; `CreateMiniDoublets` fills the stored pairs and runs the selection only past the mask. Before, creation repeated every decision of the count.
- **LS**: `CountMiniDoubletConnections` runs the full LS selection for the first 256 outer MDs of each inner MD and stores it; pairs past the mask are counted without the selection, and the looser `passLooseSegmentCuts` is removed. `CreateSegments` visits only the set bits. Before, the full selection ran at creation on every pair, and the loose count made the candidate buffer about 8 times larger.
- **T3**: `FillSegmentsByInnerMD` (new) lists the LSs starting at each MD; the T5 building uses it too, in place of `FillLSonT3ByMD`. `CountSegmentConnections` and `CreateTriplets` run flat over the LSs, visit only the LSs starting at the shared MD and store the first 32 decisions; the full T3 selection moves to `CreateTripletsFromMatches` (new), flat over the stored pairs. Before, each inner LS scanned all LSs of the middle module, one block per module.
- **T4**: `CountTripletLSConnections` and `CreateQuadruplets` run flat over the T3s; the count stores the decisions of the dense pairs for the first 32 outer T3s and the per-module counts, which `CreateEligibleModulesListForQuadruplets` reads. The count also requires equal charge of the two T3s, which master checked only at creation. `RemoveDupQuadrupletsAfterBuild` runs over the eligible modules only and `RemoveDupQuadrupletsBeforeTC` flat over the compacted T4s. The `preAllocatedTripletIndices` column is no longer needed and is removed. Before, a dense module was left to a single block or thread.

Mask widths: with 64, 256, 32 and 32 bits the decision is stored for 99.98% / 99.96% of the MD pairs, 99.99% / 99.94% of the LS pairs, 99.72% / 90.69% of the T3 candidates and 99.78% / 95.89% of the dense T4 pairs (ttbar / QCD PU200). Pairs past a mask are not dropped: the creation kernels run the selection on them, as master does for every pair. The MD, LS and T4 block shapes on the GPU are the fastest of those scanned on the L40; the T3 kernels keep master's shape.

#### PR validation:

**Timing**
hltLST in the Phase-2 HLT menus on CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-11-2300, 1 thread, median of 5 rounds, ms/event:

| | master | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| CPU menu, QCD PU200 | 1020 | 872 |
| CPU menu, ttbar PU200 | 289 | 216 |
| GPU menu (NVIDIA L40), QCD PU200 | 86.8 | 14.9 |
| GPU menu (NVIDIA L40), ttbar PU200 | 2.51 | 1.92 |

For a more detailed breakdown of the timing by kernel, see [here](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/kernels.html).

**Memory**
The buffers that change are transient, allocated and released within one stage.

HLT memory, master vs this PR (300 ttbar PU200 events, one job, means of 3 GPU-menu and 2 CPU-menu runs): GPU memory on the L40 averages 1.30 vs 1.32 GB over the job and peaks at 1.85 vs 1.75 GB; peak host memory 9.35 vs 9.36 GB (GPU menu) and 8.42 vs 8.44 GB (CPU menu). No change beyond the run-to-run spread (0.29 GB GPU peak, 0.19 GB GPU average, 0.17 and 0.19 GB host).

**Physics**
- MTV on the CPU, 500 ttbar + 500 QCD PU200 events, master vs this PR: every efficiency, fake and duplicate histogram is identical. Plots: HLT [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/hlt_ttbar/plots_hlt.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/hlt_qcd/plots_hlt.html); offline 34634.711 [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/off01_ttbar/index.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/off01_qcd/index.html); all iterations (34634.714) [ttbar](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/offall_ttbar/index.html), [QCD](https://gniendorf.github.io/lst-plots-2/internal-prs/lst-t3t4-segment-lists/offall_qcd/index.html)
title: LST: MD/LS/T3/T4 pass masks and flat T3/T4 building
